claim.why_it_matters: Heading at the wrong level: 6.4.1.3 is a child of '### 6.4.1 Transfer of Control' and a sibling of '#### 6.4.1.1' and '#### 6.4.1.2' (page 107), but is rendered at ###, the same level as its parent.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page II-24 (PDF p108) shows the heading '6.4.1.3 Scope of Names of Programs', a fourth-level number. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md, line 4739 is '### 6.4.1 Transfer of Control', lines 4747 and 4755 are '#### 6.4.1.1' and '#### 6.4.1.2', and line 4775 is '### 6.4.1.3 Scope of Names of Programs'. So 6.4.1.3 sits at the same markdown level as its parent 6.4.1 and as the next section '### 6.4.2', which breaks the outline hierarchy. The heading text is present and correct, so nothing is missing. The defect is the heading level.
verdict.corrected_description: Wrong heading level, not a missing heading. The text '6.4.1.3 Scope of Names of Programs' is present, but it is marked '###' and should be '####' to match its siblings 6.4.1.1 and 6.4.1.2 under '### 6.4.1 Transfer of Control' (specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 4775).
